# Ruckmoor Lounge

> Ruckmoor Lounge is a dive bar on N High St in Columbus with patios, fire pits, pool and cheap drinks. Rated 4.3 from 809 Google reviews.

- Type: Bar
- Address: 7496 N High St, Columbus, OH 43235, USA
- Phone: (614) 885-4468
- Website: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/ruckmoor-lounge/

- Google rating: 4.3 from 809 reviews

## About
Ruckmoor Lounge is a neighborhood bar on N High St in Columbus. One reviewer called it a place with all the joy of a great dive bar and an awkward vintage swankiness, and the indoor lounge with its fireplace and old furniture backs that up.
The bar is long and narrow, so you end up talking to the locals. One reviewer who doesn't live nearby said they stop in whenever they're in the area, and that the regulars make you feel like you belong. Guests have given us a 4.3 rating across 809 Google reviews.

## Services
- Daily drink specials: A reviewer mentioned cheap prices and daily drink specials.
- Mugs and talls on tap: One reviewer liked the tap selection and the prices on mugs, especially the talls.
- Pool tables: Rack up a game in the lounge.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Early and late, every day of the week. One reviewer pointed out the bar is only closed 3 hours a day.

Q: Do you take cards?
A: A reviewer noted the bar is cash only, with an ATM on site.

## What customers say
- "Only closed 3 hrs a day.. Dive In! You'll be surprised...
Ruckmoor Lounge is an oddly unique bar experience, diverse in every way imaginable.  All the joy of a great dive bar with an awkward vintage swankiness that reveals a deep secret history of unknown adventures past and present.

The bar layout is shotgun style, forcing interaction with the charismatic locals..prices are super cheap, killer daily drink specials, CASH ONLY with ATM onsite.
No kitchen, however BYO food is welcomed & encouraged.

Chill Zones include (2) outdoor patios with fire pits, indoor lounge with fireplace and cozy vintage furniture...reminiscent of a cigar bar or poker room and all out good vibes.

Activities include darts, pool, beer pong, ring toss, sports, keno, jukebox, ring toss, karaoke, drinking, smoking, dancing.. plus lots of hotels near by :)

Open 5:30AM to 2:30AM. Wow.
Definitely worth a visit - or become a regular!!" (Chase White, 5/5)
- "It's always a great time here.  They have a really nice indoor fire place, great seating and tables, pool tables, a couple more games, a nice patio (pronounced Pay-Shee-Oh) with an outdoor fire pit, and overall the place just has a great vibe. The staff is very friendly and outgoing. I also like their on tap selection and the pricing is great for mugs, especially their talls. The food is great. Overall, just a great bar. One of the finest bars in Central Ohio." (Izro Shaulov, 5/5)
- "Love the local bar, wish it was more local to my house, I live about 25 minutes away. I do make it a point to stop by whenever I am in the area. Great employees, affordable drinks and the regulars make you feel like you belong." (Maui Craft, 5/5)
- "For sure in my top 10 bars ever. Its nothing crazy. Awesome patio. Barmaids are always super pretty. They got a fireplace. Just go in and check it out. And if you dont like it, kick rocks" (Jake Betz, 5/5)
